calls.arg: cd /home/user/agentic-engineering-template && git status | head -3 && git log --oneline -3 && git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat

git diff origin/main...HEAD -- copier.yml && cat -n waybill/README.md waybill/AGENTS.md waybill/CLAUDE.md "waybill/{{ _copier_conf.answers_file }}.jinja" && cat -n tests/test_waybill_subtemplate.py && cat -n waybill/.github/workflows/order-check.yml.jinja && ls -la waybill

ls; for f in .github/workflows/template-update.yml.jinja scripts/ci/prune_glossary.sh scripts/ci/template-update-body.sh; do echo "== $f"; diff session-memory/$f waybill/$f && echo same; done; ls session-memory; cat -n waybill/.github/workflows/template-update.yml.jinja | sed -n 1,80p

ls session-memory && diff session-memory/.github/workflows/template-update.yml.jinja waybill/.github/workflows/template-update.yml.jinja; diff session-memory/scripts/ci/prune_glossary.sh waybill/scripts/ci/prune_glossary.sh; diff session-memory/scripts/ci/template-update-body.sh waybill/scripts/ci/template-update-body.sh

cd /home/user && ls -R agentic-engineering-template/session-memory/scripts; ls -a waybill; ls waybill/dispositions 2>&1 | head; diff waybill/AGENTS.md agentic-engineering-template/waybill/AGENTS.md; diff waybill/.github/workflows/order-check.yml agentic-engineering-template/waybill/.github/workflows/order-check.yml.jinja
